caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt with a wide, diagonally striped border in alternating red and blue colors. The interior is composed of numerous irregular polygonal patches in a variety of colors, patterns, and textures, including shades of red, blue, yellow, green, brown, black, cream, and white. Many patches are decorated with small embroidery motifs such as flowers, leaves, spirals, and geometric shapes in contrasting thread colors, notably yellow, white, red, and green. Some patches have printed or patterned designs, including florals, stripes, and checks. The overall composition is densely packed, with each fabric segment distinctly outlined, and some areas show curved or circular patch arrangements in addition to straight-edged patches. The quilt is depicted on a neutral, cream-colored background.
title: Crazy Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
